journey.name: wear receive qr rests
journey.description:
A receive QR that is not touched for 2 min rests: it hides behind the dimmed QR icon and stops holding the screen on at full brightness; a tap anywhere on the screen shows it again. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack and › Restored wallet, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped, and the always-on screen on (README › Watch gestures). Gestures are written for the 454 px screen; scale them as in README › What differs. Once the QR rests the watch may go to ambient mode, which shows the same icon; the tap then wakes the watch, which shows the QR too.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left once: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Wait up to 10 s until `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "WatchReceiveQr" (README, top)
Wait 125 s without touching the watch
Verify "WatchReceiveHidden" is listed with the content-desc "QR hidden"
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchReceiveHidden" is not listed
Verify from a screenshot that a black-on-white QR code fills the middle of the screen
